Before using a blower to clean the outside compartment of the circuit breaker 
from dust, wear your breathing mask to protect your lung tissues from the dust 
particulate.

Clean 
all outside compartment of circuit breaker from dust, oil and other things using 
blower and rags.
Retighten all bolts and earth connection parts if necessary.

Clean all 
parts of the mechanism .

Check 
oil level of main tanks for three phases.

Check 
oil leaks for all connections.

Check 
door gaskets for all panels.
Check the SF6 gas pressure this value should be 7 bar at 20 c.
Using the leak detector check the entire CB switch for SF6 gas leak.

items:
Inspect visually all components of the circuit breaker for signs of overheating in the mechanism boxes, signs of electro 
 static discharge, small oil leaks, weld cracks, 
foundation, fixation of circuit breaker. 
 etc.
Check for AC and DC supply source.
Check the hydraulic oil pressure, the pressure should be 330 bar at normal condition.
Check the operation of the hydraulic oil pump by reducing the hydraulic oil pressure (bleed a quantity of oil back into the reservoir until the pump starts).

Check 
 and record the number of hydraulic pump operations as indicated on the operation counter 
 and compare with the previous month.

Clean 
all outside compartment of circuit breaker from dust, oil and other things using 
blower and rags.
Retighten all bolts and earth connection parts if necessary.

Clean all 
parts of the mechanism .

Check 
oil level of main tanks for three phases.
Check high-pressure pipes to ensure they are in their proper locations and sealing properly.
Check the hydraulic oil reservoir tank to ensure the cap is sealing properly.

Check 
oil leaks for all connections.
Check and record the operation of the heater circuit of mechanism.

Check 
door gaskets for all panels.
Check the SF6 gas pressure this value should be 7 bar at 20 c.
Using the leak detector check the entire CB switch for SF6 gas leak.
